text:
Seedance 2.0 got hit by Hollywood 🎬⚖️

so devs did the obvious thing

put it inside n8n 🤖

it’s just another step in a workflow now

hard to “pause” something like that

repo below 👇 https://t.co/I1J4YVYr8u
content: Integrate Seedance 2.0 into an n8n workflow so video generation runs as a step in an automated pipeline.
